object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G55 (D-G25), Q-G6. A checksum on the same page as the installer protects against a damaged download, not a replaced one. The means, decided on 2026-11-11: a build-provenance attestation from the release workflow, with the command to check it in INSTALL.md.
object.description: Each published release of Mellon could let a user check, without relying on the release page alone, that the Windows installer was built from the release's tagged source.
